description: This file defines an ApiService class that provides a lightweight REST API client wrapper around the http package. It manages base URL configuration from environment variables, authorization headers, and supports methods for GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE HTTP requests, including error handling.

classes.name: ApiService
classes.description: A lightweight REST API client that wraps the http package, adding support for base URL, authorization headers, and query parameters.

classes.name: HttpException
classes.description: Custom exception class for HTTP errors, capturing the response body for debugging purposes.

methods.name: updateToken
methods.description: Updates the bearer token used in subsequent requests.

methods.name: _uri
methods.description: Constructs a full Uri from a relative path and optional query parameters, using the base URL from environment variables.

methods.name: _headers
methods.description: Constructs request headers, including Content-Type, Accept, and Authorization if a token is set.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified path with optional query parameters.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request to the specified path with optional body, query, and headers.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PUT request to the specified path with an optional body.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request to the specified path.

methods.name: _throwIfError
methods.description: Throws an HttpException if the HTTP response indicates an error (status code >= 400).
